# Stranded. Tormented. Alone.
**By Grit Alone** is an action horror shooter combining frantic combat with a harrowing sci-fi anthology story. Uncover mysteries and endure the relentless alien hordes in this handcrafted linear narrative campaign, focusing on constant action and cosmic dread.


{325644213932403}
# Trapped out of Space
You’re marooned in a bizarre unknown dimension, filled with ancient derelicts and ravenous aliens. Uncover the mysteries of the dead as you move ship to ship, slaughtering your way through hordes of brain starved horrors.

{997788672356835}

# Fight to survive
with death crawling over the walls, ceilings and floors. Disgusting insectiods and flesh constructs stalk you. If the swarm doesn't take you, the deathtrap wreckages, rogue AIs, or hard vacuum will.

{440826248761969}

# A Sci-Fi Anthology Narrative
where each disturbing derelict is the twisted brainchild of a different writer, from the minds behind Dead Space, Resident Evil 8, Dr Who and many more...

{849131497113183}

VR Action Horror focusing on deep lore, intense violence and cosmic dread. A linear narrative campaign designed for constant tension, action and immersion, heavily inspired by DeadSpace, Resident Evil 4 and Bioshock. There's no loading screens, no inventory and unlimited ammo; you need skill and speed to rip through the ferocious swarms and get out of this corrupted hellhole in one piece.

# By Grit Alone, you will survive.
